'''Irene Wagner-Döbler''' is a German microbiologist and associate professor of biology at the Institute of Microbiology, [[Technical University of Braunschweig]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Irene Wagner-Döbler, Institute of Microbiology, Technische Universität Braunschweig |url=https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/en/mibi/departments/irene-wagner-doebler |access-date=27 July 2023 |website=Institute of Microbiology, Technische Universität Braunschweig}}</ref>

== Career ==
Irene Wagner-Döbler studied biology at [[LMU Munich]] and obtained her PhD in 1984 with a thesis in aquatic ecology.<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek |url=https://d-nb.info/850752035 |access-date=2023-03-20 |website=portal.dnb.de|last1=Wagner-DöBler |first1=Irene }}</ref> In 2001, she obtained her [[habilitation]] at the [[Technical University of Braunschweig]]. Her habilitation dealt with the detoxification of mercury-containing wastewater using a newly discovered ''[[Pseudomonas|Pseudomonas putida]] strain'' and a [[bioreactor]] specifically developed for this purpose.<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=Towards an understanding of microbial communities in nature and the development of novel microbiological remediation technologies |url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=idn%3D968376835 |first=Irene |last=Wagner-Döbler}}</ref> For this work she received the "Stifterverband Science Award - Erwin-Schrödinger Preis"<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Stifterverband Science Award – Erwin-Schrödinger Prize |url=https://www.helmholtz.de/en/about-us/who-we-are/research-awards/the-stifterverband-science-award-erwin-schroedinger-prize/ |access-date=2023-07-27 |website=Helmholtz-Gemeinschaft Deutscher Forschungszentren |language=en-GB}}</ref> of the [[Helmholtz Association|Helmholtz-Association of German Research Centers]] in 2001.<ref>[https://www.helmholtz.de/ueber-uns/wer-wir-sind/forschungspreise/erwin-schroedinger-preis/ ''Wissenschaftspreis des Stifterverbandes - Erwin-Schrödinger-Preis.''] In: ''helmholtz.de.'' Retrieved September 15, 2022.</ref>

As a research group leader at the [[Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research]] (2004-2018) and associate professor at the Technical University Braunschweig (from 2007) AG Wagner-Döbler, she focused on microbial communication, in particular [[quorum sensing]] and algal-bacterial interactions in the ocean (Roseobacter Transregio<ref>{{Cite web |title=DFG - GEPRIS - TRR 51: Ecology, Physiology and Molecular Biology of the Roseobacter Clade: Towards a Systems Biology Understanding of a Globally Important Clade of Marine Bacteria |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/gepris/projekt/34509606?language=en |access-date=2023-07-27 |website=gepris.dfg.de}}</ref>). 

She is the author of more than 150 scientific papers,<ref>[https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=7004420499 ''Scopus.com Wagner-Döbler, Irene.''] In: ''scopus.com.'' Retrieved September 15, 2022.]</ref> with publications including ''de novo'' sequencing of the algal symbiont ''Dinoroseobacter shibae'' and its dinoflagellate host ''Prorocentrum cordatum.''
